reasonForPivot: Previous priority-122 diamond denominator and priority-104 milling/Gem Finding families already have model proposals and await independent observations. Priority-102 Dragonflight prospecting has 38 E and probability gaps; improve decision-error prioritization without inventing yield rates.

mathematicalContract.outputExpectedQuantity: Unconditional units per completed cast, not conditional yield and never multiplied by occurrence probability again
mathematicalContract.expectedRevenue: Sum over selected outputs of E_i * quotedPrice_i * (1-feeRate). Marginal co-output probabilities need not sum to 1 and output independence is not assumed.
mathematicalContract.bounds: Scenario lower and upper expected-quantity intervals are user-supplied hypotheses, not measured Retail rates. Unknown upper is null, never zero.
mathematicalContract.comparison: Prospect net scenario = otherRevenue + sum(outputRevenue) - inputCost - deposit. Compare only with a user-supplied alternative net using the same cost/accounting basis.
mathematicalContract.breakEven: For each output, required unconditional E is computed holding every other output at its own supplied lower or upper bound; no midpoint or min/max tooltip quantity is used as gold EV.
mathematicalContract.sensitivity: Width of hypothetical net-value interval for an output equals (E_upper-E_lower)*net output price; unknown upper yields null sensitivity.
mathematicalContract.priceContext: Caller must supply date, scenario source, ore cost, alternative net, fee, deposit and prices. No current AH/TSM values are claimed.
mathematicalContract.contextGates: Exact stable keys, ore input family, explicit nominal batch size, gross-versus-refund-adjusted cost basis, no selected-output double counting, no unknown-as-zero conversion.

forbidden: Use hypothetical scenario ranking as actual recommended liquidation action

Use tooltip yield range midpoint for EV

identifiability.fromMissingEWithoutStudy: Not identifiable; model does not estimate game drop probabilities or yields.
identifiability.fromScenarioPricesAndBounds: Break-even thresholds and conditional decision stability only; not a posterior estimate of current-patch rates.
identifiability.unknownUpper: Upper EV and proof of alternative dominance are unavailable; may still show lower-bound scenario dominance if it exists.
identifiability.independentValidation: No real Retail holdout. Independent validator must replay arithmetic with held-out synthetic scenarios and review source/epoch/cost-context gates.

Keep Serevite/Draconium rank IDs and Prismatic Ore second-stage results separate.
